mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO app_notification (user_id, type, title, content, link_url, dedupe_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{dedupeKey})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE app_notification SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE role_code = 'ADMIN' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT DISTINCT tm.user_id FROM team_manager tm JOIN app_user u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT f.id AS fixture_id, ht.name AS home_team_name, at.name AS away_team_name, f.kickoff_at FROM fixture f JOIN team_manager tm ON tm.user_id = #{userId} AND (tm.team_id = f.home_team_id OR tm.team_id = f.away_team_id) JOIN team ht ON ht.id = f.home_team_id JOIN team at ON at.id = f.away_team_id WHERE f.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND f.kickoff_at IS NOT NULL AND f.kickoff_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{until} ORDER BY f.kickoff_at, f.id
